thread:
maria_marketing: Hey all — quick heads up: HelioEdge (pilot customer) is ready for a customer story. They gave a great quote in the pilot wrap — want to turn this into a short case study + a co-hosted 30-min webinar next sprint. Need interview scheduling, final quote sign-off, legal release, and a publish+webinar timeline.

owen_content: Awesome — I can take the interview. Do we have a primary contact at HelioEdge and an initial draft quote to share?

maria_marketing: Contact is Priya Rao (Head of Data). She said she's comfortable on camera and can do a 20–30 min interview. Draft quote in my doc: "Redwood's batching and KV caching cut inference cost by ~45% and let us ship predictive features at 3x lower latency." — want legal to look at wording.

dina_legal: Thanks — please send the full transcript and the exact quote text for approval. High-level: we need a signed release form (I can share our standard template) and confirm no sensitive product numbers in the quote. Also flagging that mentioning the specific 45% number needs either customer attestation or anonymized phrasing.

maria_marketing: Copy. I'll ask Priya to confirm the percentage or we’ll change to "nearly half" if they want. Booking options I proposed to Priya:
```
- Tue 9/21 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 9/22 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 9/24 11:00–11:30 PT
```
She prefers Wed.

tim_events: Wed works for me too. For the webinar tie-in: we should position it as a 30-min product+customer story with a short demo (10 min), then customer fireside (15 min) + Q&A. Can we get a lightweight benchmark slide (1 slide) comparing latency/cost pre/post? Owen — can you whip that up from Maria's notes?

owen_content: Yep — I'll do a one-slide before/after with the numbers and a simple chart. Will use anonymized phrasing if Dina requests it.

sam_ops: Logistics: webinar slot availability looks good on Wed 9/22 at 10:30 PT for our default webinar cadence. If we need co-hosting, I need the speaker emails to add to the platform and generate joins. Also recommending we record and transcribe; I can auto-gen captions.

maria_marketing: Speakers: Priya Rao (HelioEdge), Alex (product lead), me as moderator. Priya said to use the HelioEdge logo in the banner — legal, ok?

dina_legal: Logos are fine as long as customer approves the asset. I'll send the release + logo permission checklist. For the quote: if Priya confirms the 45% number in writing, that's fine; otherwise we request she confirm an acceptable phrasing. I'll turn around the release within 24 hours.

maria_marketing: Perfect. Owen — can you draft the case study copy (600–800 words) and the one-slide benchmark by tomorrow EOD? Tim — can you tentatively block Wed 9/22 10:30 PT on the events calendar and add the recording/transcription step. Sam — add speaker invites once we have emails.

owen_content: On it. I'll post the draft here when ready for edits.

publish-bot: [auto] embargo window set to 2024-09-29T17:00:00Z if marketing requests +7 days after webinar; update with final publish date to lock.

maria_marketing: Thanks. Action items recap:
- Maria: confirm quote phrasing with Priya + collect signed release (by EOD tomorrow)
- Owen: draft case study + benchmark slide (EOD tomorrow)
- Dina: send release + logo checklist (within 24h)
- Tim: block webinar slot tentatively (done) and coordinate demo time
- Sam: prepare recording/transcribe + speaker invites when emails available

maria_marketing: Will follow up with a short checklist thread once draft arrives. :thumbsup:
